answer: Like a deep meadow bound by mycelium, our consensus anchors trust in cryptographic roots rather than fleeting identities. When a rogue nebula of phantom clones attempts infiltration, transitive staking bows resiliently like a willow, absorbing the strain through localized slashing. Forging consensus requires cross-verified stake depth, imposing superlinear attacker cost that scales exponentially with each counterfeit clone spawned.
